_pre_countdown_delay_comment: Silent live-view seconds before every visible countdown.
_countdown_seconds_comment: Visible countdown before capture. 3 means show 3, 2, 1.
_countdown_sound_seconds_comment: How many last countdown ticks play sound. 0 disables countdown beeps.
_done_screen_seconds_comment: Seconds to keep the final/done screen before returning to idle.
_photo_choice_default_with_frame_comment: Which variant a photo_choice template opens on: false shows the plain photo first, true shows the framed one. Also used when the guest never chooses and default_template has photo_choice.
_multi_print_enabled_comment: Show the multi-select button on the template screen. It only ever appears while technical_event_name is the active event, so guest events keep the plain one-tap choice.
_multi_print_max_sheets_comment: Maximum number of 4x6 sheets one multi-select basket may print. One strips sheet already holds two strips. Range 1..20.
_live_view_fit_comment: contain shows the full Canon EVF frame with black bars; cover fills the display by cropping edges.
_live_view_margin_comment: Safe black margins for monitor areas hidden by the physical frame. The bottom margin also holds the look-at-lens hint; 12% leaves it readable on a Full HD screen. Adjust independently from 0 to 25.
_pose_examples_per_side_comment: Number of pose examples in each side margin. Files are auto-discovered in assets/poses. Every session shuffles the pool, and each captured frame consumes twice this number without repeats. Any aspect ratio is preserved. Set 0 to hide them.
_live_view_warmup_comment: Seconds to wait after EVF start before showing live view. Camera flushes stale buffered frames during this time.
_show_qr_comment: Show a direct Yandex.Disk link to the current <event>_by_sessions folder while media uploads.
_technical_event_name_comment: When this exact event is active, the idle screen stays locked until an admin grants sessions with /unblock.
_technical_event_price_rubles_comment: Price shown on the idle-screen badge only while technical_event_name is the active event. Set 0 to hide the badge.
_keep_custom_print_files_comment: Keep Telegram source images and prepared 4x6 JPEGs under photos_print_jobs/<job_id> after printing.
_printer_name_comment: Exact Windows printer queue name. Empty uses Photobooth user's default printer.
_printer_name_strips_comment: Optional second queue with DNP 2inch cut enabled for strips.
_print_dpi_comment: DPI metadata written into composed JPEGs. Paper, quality, borderless mode and copies come from the saved Windows queue defaults.
_yadisk_folder_comment: Event folder where media files are uploaded. Session notifications use yadisk_control_folder/to_vps.
_yadisk_updates_folder_comment: Private Disk folder with the full update artifact and status.json. Must match VPS.
_yadisk_control_folder_comment: Stable private bus: to_booth, to_vps and logs. Processed command and response JSON files are deleted. Must match VPS.
